title: Multi-Agent AI System for Radiology Report Structuring and Quality Assurance with Independent Radiologist Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2608.18072v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Purpose: To develop and evaluate a locally deployed multi-agent AI system for radiology report structuring and quality assurance. Materials and Methods: This retrospective study included 638 radiology reports from CT examinations of the chest, abdomen, and pelvis dictated by 15 board-certified radiologists in 2023 and 2024. A multi-agent AI pipeline was developed to perform report structuring and quality assurance (QA). The system structured the report into standardized anatomical sections at the sentence level using regex rules and local large language models. It also detected mismatches between the Findings and Impression sections, or within sections; gender-anatomy conflicts; and undocumented communication of critical findings. Two board-certified radiologists independently evaluated a 45-report subset. Results: The multi-agent system structured the Findings sections of all reports (22,270 sentences) into a predefined anatomical forma

translated_title: 多智能体AI系统用于放射学报告结构化与质量保证，并接受独立放射科医生评估
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.18072v1 公告类型：新 摘要：目的：开发并评估一个本地部署的多智能体AI系统，用于放射学报告的结构化和质量保证。材料与方法：这项回顾性研究纳入了2023年和2024年由15名委员会认证的放射科医生口述的638份胸部、腹部和盆腔CT检查的放射学报告。开发了一个多智能体AI流水线来执行报告结构化和质量保证（QA）。该系统使用正则规则和本地大型语言模型，在句子级别将报告结构化为标准化的解剖部分。它还检测了“发现”和“印象”部分之间或部分内部的不匹配、性别与解剖学冲突，以及未记录的关键发现沟通。两名委员会认证的放射科医生独立评估了一个包含45份报告的子集。结果：多智能体系统将所有报告的“发现”部分（共22,270个句子）结构化为预定义的解剖格式。
tldr: 该系统通过本地多智能体AI流水线，实现放射学报告的结构化与质量保证，能自动检测报告内部不一致、性别冲突和关键发现沟通遗漏，并经独立放射科医生验证其有效性。
en_tdlr: This system uses a locally deployed multi-agent AI pipeline to structure radiology reports and ensure quality, automatically detecting internal inconsistencies, gender-anatomy conflicts, and undocumented critical findings, with effectiveness validated by independent radiologists.
